figurative_meaning_en: A special method of maintaining business account ledgers
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুরনো দোকানগুলোতে তকরারী জমাখরচের পদ্ধতি এখনও ব্যবহৃত হয়।
তার ব্যবসায়ে তকরারী জমাখরচ রাখার কারণে হিসাব সবসময় সঠিক থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: Old shops still use the takrari jama-kharach method for accounting.
His business maintains accurate records thanks to the takrari jama-kharach system.
history: This idiom refers to a traditional Bengali accounting practice from the colonial era, using ledger books to track receipts and expenditures in mercantile trade.
note: Primarily used in historical or traditional business contexts in Bengal.
